title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for Curren Chan's second Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Racecourse is livelier today than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, I heard they're gonna show a special broadcast on the big screen before the race!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Everyone, be quiet! It's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buono, everyone! ♪ For today's meal—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! We're s'posed to be talkin' 'bout how excited we are for today's race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! ♪ Um… There are so many spectators today!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Have a good race, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wowie, now that's what I call a cheer! Thank you so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're all pleased as punch to see so many of y'all out here to support us! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's right. Bigger is better, after all! That goes for your cheering voices and everything else! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And since I'm the biggest star here today, I think that mea—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: STOP! Not. One. More. Word! As the class representative, it's m—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yessiree! And I'm as big as anyone! That's why this race's in the bag! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I! Wanted! To! Be! The! LEADER!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Well, I'm ready to put up a big fight today too, so watch out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hold on! Me too! I'm gonna wiiin!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! As you can see, we're all very excited. And now, it's time for the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We're all so happy to have so many people watching today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now, I've got a personal message for all the people here at the racecourse and those of you watching from home…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking alllll of your hearts today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hey! That's a foul! No false starts allowed!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoopsie! You caught me! On that note…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We can't wait to hear everyone cheering! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I'm starting to get excited!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I knew everyone's eyes would be on Curren Chan—she planned the whole thing! I'm excited to see how this turns out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan Follower
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan! Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: What in the world is going on? It feels like we're at the Arima Kinen or something.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: You don't know? Try looking up "Cutie ♪ Derby"!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: …"Cutie ♪ Derby"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tap, tap, ta-tap, tap…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's this?! It's…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Sooooo cuuuuute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Wow. We can hear the fans all the way over here.
choice_data_list: That's the effect of the Cutie ♪ Derby.
That's the effect of the Cutie ♪ Derby.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I guess you're right. It's just like I planned—no, it's even better.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We've got all eyes on us. We've got the absolute best competitors. We've set up the perfect shining stage…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now, all that's left is for me to become the most beloved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is unusually nervous, though it comes as no surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day we find out if the path she—we—chose was the right one.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I just wanna ask you one thing. Today… Am I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Yeah, that's perfect. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Then, here I go! I'm gonna deliver my cuteness to everyone!
